Built by hand.
Built to last.

Faizan Grill & Fabrication Works makes stainless steel and mild steel work for homes, shops and sheds on Jawargi Road. Every gate, grill, railing and frame is measured on site, cut to size and welded in our own workshop.

We choose strong materials, keep our welds clean and finish each piece the way the customer asked for it. No two jobs are the same, so we build to your design, your budget and your space.
